title: Dogs of New York — nyc_license
text: data sourced DOHMH Dog Licensing System (https://a816-healthpsi.nyc.gov/DogLicense), owners can apply renew dog licenses. record represents unique dog license active year, necessarily unique record per dog, since license renewed year results separate record active license period. Licenses valid one five years. breed_rc recoded version breed_name: Inverted names put usual order, e.g. "Bull Dog, French" becomes "French Bulldog". Varieties collapsed breed, e.g. "Dachshund Smooth Coat" "Dachshund, Long Haired Miniature" become "Dachshund"; "Poodle, Toy" "Poodle, Standard" become "Poodle"; "Collie, Rough Coat" becomes "Collie". Breeds distinct, Miniature, Standard, Giant Schnauzers Pembroke Cardigan Welsh Corgis, kept apart. Long, abbreviated, misspelled names standardized, e.g. "American Pit Bull Terrier/Pit Bull" becomes "Pit Bull" "Cav Kc" becomes "Cavalier King Charles Spaniel". Crossbreeds kept distinct breed labeled consistently, e.g. "Terrier Mix", "Terrier X", "Terrier Crossbreed" "Terrier Crossbreed". Free-text descriptions two breeds, e.g. "Beagle/Boxer", left . lookup table used data-raw/breed_recodes.csv package source. breed_rc nyc_bites coded way. data deliberately lightly cleaned. Owner-provided values kept reported, including placeholder names (e.g. "Unknown", "Name provided"), implausible birth years, malformed zip codes.
